bar.assets.tip: Show or hide the asset panel
bar.new.tip: New project: create a project folder from the template with an empty timeline, asset folders, CLAUDE.md, and git. The current project stays open
bar.dur.tip: Duration (set in seconds, extend, or fit to the last clip). Placing a clip past the end extends it automatically
bar.size.tip: Frame size (FHD landscape, FHD portrait, square)
bar.still.tip: Save the current frame as PNG (output/stills/, re-rendered losslessly)
bar.reload.tip: Reload the editor after saving finishes (keeps playhead and selection). External changes to the timeline, takes, and images reload automatically; use this if they don't

bar.fit.tip: Zoom to fit the whole timeline (F)
tp.wheel: Mouse wheel here: step one frame (Shift: one second)
tp.pvScale.tip: Preview size while paused. Frames render at full size and are scaled down, so render time is similar while transferred images are lighter (useful remotely). PNG stills and exports are always full size
tl.endZone: Past the end: placing or moving a clip here extends the video up to it
st.alreadySaved: Already saved (every change is saved automatically)
re.title: Could not render the frame at {t} s

st.proxyFail: Cannot play the playback video ({why}). Showing frames as they are rendered
lg.title: Messages and log
lg.tip: Click to show the full text and the recent log (you can copy them)
pf.stuck: the video does not advance (readyState {rs}, networkState {ns}, paused {paused})
src.proxyRendering: Exported version ({name}) … rendering the current timeline
src.prevRendering: Previous frame … rendering the current timeline
src.blRendering: Previous frame … rendering Blender 3D (a few seconds in draft quality when no frame is kept)
src.currentScaled: Current timeline (rendered in {sec} s, scaled to 1/{k})

bake.tipOff: Background rendering is off. Click to turn it on (resumes when playback stops and you release controls)
bake.cfgOff: The setting mittler.bake.jobs is 0, so nothing is rendered in the background
bake.stOff: Background rendering turned off (click to turn back on)
bake.stOn: Background rendering turned on (starts when playback stops and you release controls)
pl.longVideo: The planned video is {s} s long. Over {max} s, H3 generation takes much longer; splitting into 2–{max} s clips is recommended
cache.barTip: Green marks: cached frames of the current timeline ({n} / {total}). Frames ahead of the playhead are rendered and cached in the background when idle
src.noProxy: Current timeline (no playback video; frames as rendered)
cut.label: Cut {label}
clip.subtitle: (subtitle)
meta.cutItemTip: (drag an edge to move the boundary with the adjacent cut; double-click to split; right-click to join, delete, or rename. Video clips stay put)
meta.itemTip: (drag to move; drag an edge to trim; double-click empty space to add; right-click for menu)
meta.emptyCuts: Double-click or click ＋ next to the name to create the first cut (whole video), then split it
meta.emptyNotes: Double-click or click ＋ next to the name to add a note
meta.addCutSplit: Split the cut at the playhead (also right-click or double-click)
meta.addCutFirst: Create the first cut covering the whole video (also via right-click or double-click)
meta.addItem: Add {name} at the playhead (also right-click or double-click)
kind.subtitle: Subtitles
tr.shyOn: Shy (hidden by Shy above). Click to unmark
tr.shyOff: Mark as shy (Shy above can hide it from the timeline)
tr.mute: Mute (keeps the track, but skips playback and export)
tr.visible: Visible (click to hide: keeps the track, but skips rendering and export)

bar.shy.hiding.one: Hiding {n} shy track (click to show all). Rendering and export are not affected
bar.shy.hiding.other: Hiding {n} shy tracks (click to show all). Rendering and export are not affected

bar.shy.hide: Shy: hide tracks marked shy ({n}) from the timeline. Rendering and export are not affected
bar.follow.tipOn: Auto follow: ON. When AI, the API, or an external file edit updates the timeline, the playhead jumps to the middle of the changed clip and highlights it. Click to turn off
bar.follow.tipOff: Auto follow: OFF. The playhead stays put when the AI changes the timeline. Click to turn on
st.followOn: Auto follow on: the playhead jumps to what the AI changes
rm.notReady: The editor has not loaded the timeline yet
file.title: {name} ({file})
fh.durTip: Length in frames ({fps} fps). The value in seconds snaps to frames
fh.startTip: Start frame number ({fps} fps, counted like the f under the preview). The value in seconds snaps to frames
sel.empty: Click a clip in the timeline (Delete to remove, Ctrl+Z to undo)
sel.blRedraw.tip: Delete this clip's kept Blender frames and re-render the current frame. Previews use draft quality; PNG stills and exports use final quality

sel.blScene.tip: Open the scene script (scene) in VS Code

st.blCleared.one: Blender 3D: deleted the kept frames ({n} file)
st.blCleared.other: Blender 3D: deleted the kept frames ({n} files)

st.blClearFailed: Blender 3D: couldn't delete the kept frames: {err}
st.durExtended: {icon:timer} Extended the duration to {d} (a clip was placed past the end; Ctrl+Z to undo)
st.durSet: {icon:timer} Set the duration to {d} (Ctrl+Z to undo)
dur.label: Duration (s)

st.extUndo: Undid the external change (from Claude Code, etc.) and restored the file. Press Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo
toast.extUndo: Undid the external change (from Claude Code, etc.). Press Ctrl+Z again to undo your own edit, or Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo
st.extRedo: Redid the external change (from Claude Code, etc.). Press Ctrl+Z to undo
st.extReloaded: The timeline was changed outside the editor, so it was reloaded
st.saveFailed: {icon:triangle-alert} Could not save ({why}). Retrying in {wait} s (attempt {n})
st.endAfterStartBoth: The end must be after the start (applied once both are valid)
st.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start
st.codeOpened: Opened {path} in VS Code (saving it re-renders)
st.slipOnly: Slip works only on audio and video clips (not on videos with beat-sync points or a time table)
st.sizeSet: {icon:ratio} Set the frame size to {w}×{h} (Ctrl+Z to undo)
st.stillRendering: {icon:camera} Rendering the frame at {t} as PNG…
st.stillSaved: {icon:camera} Saved: {path} ({mb} MB). Click here to open
st.rendererStarting: Starting the render server on this PC…
meta.labelTip: Label (changing it also updates the cut of clips that refer to this label)
meta.joinPrev: Join with the previous cut (merge this cut into it)
meta.joinNext: Join with the next cut (merge it into this cut)
meta.delCut: Delete (merge into the previous cut, or the next one if this is the first)
meta.align.tip: Align this cut's video clip edges to the cut (source timing stays; frames outside the boundary don't change)
meta.alignAll.tip: Align the video clip edges of every cut marked with a warning (nothing changes if any of them can't be aligned)
meta.cutNote: Moving a cut's start or end moves the neighboring cut's edge so no gaps form. Video clips stay put; cuts whose video no longer matches show {icon:triangle-alert} (use “{icon:film} Fit video to cut”). Renaming, splitting, or joining also updates clips that reference the label (color grading, per-cut effects, and video cut)
src.gradePreview: Approximate color (re-renders from the current timeline when you release)
cgrade.title: {icon:palette} Clip color
cgrade.note: Applied right after reading this clip's frames, before effects, and moves with the clip. Separate from cut color in the Color tab; both apply
snap.tipOn: Snap (S): on. Snaps to: {list}. Hold Alt while dragging to invert
snap.tipOff: Snap (S): off. Snaps to: {list}. Hold Alt while dragging to invert
snap.tipOnNone: Snap (S): on. No snap targets selected. Hold Alt while dragging to invert
snap.tipOffNone: Snap (S): off. No snap targets selected. Hold Alt while dragging to invert
size.note: Text and overlay positions are in pixels, so check them after changing the size. The playback video keeps the old size until you export again
ce.noSplit: {icon:scissors} No clip to split at {t} (only video, image, audio, dialogue and subtitle clips; videos with a beat-sync table can't be split)
ce.gapsPick: {icon:arrow-left-to-line} Select a clip (or a track) in the track whose gaps to close

ce.copied.one: {icon:copy} Copied {n} clip (Ctrl+V pastes at the playhead)
ce.copied.other: {icon:copy} Copied {n} clips (Ctrl+V pastes at the playhead)

ce.linkOn: {icon:link} Link sync on (linked clips move together)
ce.linkOff: {icon:link} Link sync off (clips move one at a time)
ce.linkPick: Select two or more clips to link (Ctrl+click)
ce.joinedNoAudio: Can't extract audio from a joined video (two or more files)
ce.placedLinked: {icon:film} Placed the video with its audio linked (on the “Video audio” track)
ce.placedSilent: {icon:film} Placed the video (it has no audio)
ce.placedNoAudio: {icon:film} Placed the video (couldn't extract its audio: {err})
ce.vaPick: {icon:volume-2} Select the video clips to extract audio from
ce.vaSpeed: audio can't be synced to a speed-changed video

ce.vaPlaced.one: {icon:volume-2} Placed {n} audio clip on the “Video audio” track
ce.vaPlaced.other: {icon:volume-2} Placed {n} audio clips on the “Video audio” track

ce.vaPlacedSkip.one: {icon:volume-2} Placed {n} audio clip on the “Video audio” track (skipped: {skip})
ce.vaPlacedSkip.other: {icon:volume-2} Placed {n} audio clips on the “Video audio” track (skipped: {skip})

tool.select.tip: Select (V): click to select, drag to move, drag an edge to trim. Ctrl/Shift+click to add, Shift+drag on empty space to box-select
tool.razor.tip: Razor (C): click a clip to split it there (Shift+click: all tracks)
tool.slip.tip: Slip (Y): keep position and length, shift which part of the source plays (in point; audio and video)
ce.btn.split.tip: Split at the playhead (Ctrl+K): the selection, or everything under the playhead if nothing is selected. Ctrl+Shift+K always splits everything
ce.btn.ripple.tip: Ripple delete (Shift+Delete): delete and close up the rest of the track
ce.btn.gaps.tip: Close gaps: remove the gaps in the selected clips' tracks
ce.btn.paste.tip: Paste (Ctrl+V): at the playhead, on the same track
ce.btn.linkon.tip: Link sync: select, move, split and delete linked clips (a video and its audio, etc.) together
ce.btn.vaudio.tip: Extract the selected videos' audio and place it, linked, on the “Video audio” track
ce.btn.latest.tip: For each planned shot, select the newest video take and place it on the video track (replacing any adopted take). One Ctrl+Z undoes all
why.noSel: No clip selected (click a clip in the timeline)
why.noCopy: Nothing copied yet (select clips and press Ctrl+C)
why.link2: Select two or more clips to link (Ctrl/Shift+click to add)
why.notLinked: The selected clips are not linked
why.noVideo: No video clip selected (click a video on a video track)
why.noGapsSel: No clip or track selected (click a clip in the track, or the track name)
why.noNewTakes: No new video takes to place yet (available once a planned shot has a generated video)
ce.selN: {n} clips selected (drag to move them together)
ce.hintRazor: {icon:scissors} Click a clip to split it there
ce.hintSlip: {icon:move-horizontal} Drag an audio or video clip left or right
cm.waitFx: Cuts lane: loading the effect list (needed to tell per-cut effects apart). Try again in a moment
cm.warn: The video clips (cut {label}) span {a}–{b}, while the cut spans {c}–{d}. The video was not moved, so the mismatched part has no video for this cut
cm.err.outside: {c} would end up entirely outside the cut (check the order of the cut's video clips)
cm.err.plan: {c} is a {icon:clapperboard} planned shot (its image change depends on the clip length)
cm.err.popHead: {c} is a pop-in image (timed from the clip start)
cm.err.tableHead: {c} uses a beat-sync table file, so its start can't move; use “Make editable (convert to points)” in the panel first
cm.err.tableTail: {c} has a beat-sync table file (can't extend beyond the table)
cm.err.landHead: {c} lands on its last frame (land: the length decides the start)
cm.err.landTail: {c} lands on its last frame (land: changing the length changes the frames shown)
cm.err.shortHead: {c} has too little source (extending the start to {t} would go before 0 s of the source)
cm.err.shortHeadIn: {c} has too little source (extending the start to {t} would go before 0 s of the source; current source in point {in} s)
cm.err.noLen: {c}: the source length is unknown (only known for single-file videos listed in the asset panel)
cm.err.shortTail: {c} has too little source (extending the end to {t} needs {need} s of source, but it is {have} s)
cm.alignFail: {icon:film} Can't fit cut {label}'s video to the cut: {err}. Nothing was changed
cm.alignNone: {icon:film} No video to fit (no cut is marked {icon:triangle-alert})
cm.aligned: {icon:film} Fitted the video to the cuts ({list}; source timing unchanged, so frames outside the boundaries stay the same)
cm.stillOff: {icon:triangle-alert} Cuts still off: {list} (part of the cut has no video)
cm.edgeMoved.boundary: Moved the boundary of cut {pair} to {t} (per-cut effects were adjusted too; video clips were not moved)
cm.edgeMoved.start: Moved the start of cut {pair} to {t} (per-cut effects were adjusted too; video clips were not moved)
cm.edgeMoved.end: Moved the end of cut {pair} to {t} (per-cut effects were adjusted too; video clips were not moved)
cm.edgeWarn: {icon:triangle-alert} {w}  {icon:play} Click here to fit the video to the cut
cm.timesSame: The cut times didn't change (a neighboring cut can't become shorter than one frame; no gaps or overlaps are made)
cm.whyNot.table: the video with a beat-sync table
cm.whyNot.land: the video that lands on its last frame (land)
cm.splitInside: {icon:scissors} Split inside cut {label} (at least one frame away from its edges)
cm.splitNo: {icon:scissors} Can't split cut {label} at {t}: {what} “{name}” spans that point, and splitting would change what is shown
cm.splitDone: {icon:scissors} Split cut {old} at {t} and created cut {label}
cm.splitPic: , split {n} spanning videos at the same point
cm.splitFx: , copied {n} spanning effects including color grading for cut {label} with the same values
cm.noCutHere: {icon:scissors} No cut at the playhead (between cuts or outside them)
cm.joined: Joined cut {g} into cut {k} ({n} clips of cut {g} moved to cut {k}
cm.joinedDrop: ; removed {n} overlapping effects already on cut {k}—color grading, per-cut effects, and split copies—keeping cut {k}'s values
cm.joinFirst: This is the first cut, so it can't join the previous one
cm.joinLast: This is the last cut, so it can't join the next one
cm.removeLast: The only remaining cut can't be deleted (edit its label or times, or create another cut first)
cm.labelDup: Cut {label} already exists (each cut needs its own label)
cm.renamed: Renamed cut {old} to “{label}” ({n} clips referring to the label were updated too). Ctrl+Z to undo
cm.rangeShort: the range is shorter than one frame
cm.rangeSpans: the range ({a}–{b}) spans cut {labels} (only a range inside one cut, or where there is no cut, can become a cut)
cm.rangeExistV: This range is already cut {label} (set the video clip's cut to this label)
cm.rangeMade: {icon:scissors} Made {a}–{b} into cut {label}. Ctrl+Z to undo
cm.rangeMadeV: {icon:scissors} Made {a}–{b} into cut {label} (the video clip's cut is this label too). Ctrl+Z to undo
cm.adoptOn: {icon:clapperboard} When adopting, the planned shot's range becomes a cut (remembered for this project)
cm.firstCut: {icon:scissors} Created cut 1 (whole video). Split it by double-clicking the cuts lane or with “{icon:scissors} Split” at the playhead. Ctrl+Z to undo
cm.firstCutConv: {icon:scissors} Created cut 1 (whole video) and assigned {n} whole-video items such as color grading to it. Double-click the cuts lane or use “{icon:scissors} Split” at the playhead to divide it. Ctrl+Z to undo
cm.cutsExists: There is already a cuts lane
cm.cutsMade: {icon:scissors} Created the cuts lane. Double-click it to create the first cut (Ctrl+Z to undo)
cm.notesExists: There is already a notes lane
cm.notesMade: {icon:sticky-note} Created the notes lane. Add notes by double-clicking or clicking ＋ next to the lane name (Ctrl+Z to undo)
cm.noCutHereDrag: There is no cut here (between cuts or outside them). Drag a cut's edge to widen it
cm.itemAdded: Added {name} at {t} (edit the text in the right panel. Ctrl+Z to undo)
cm.menu.head: {name} ({t})
cm.menu.joinp: ← Join with the previous cut (merge this cut into it)
cm.menu.joinn: Join with the next cut → (merge it into this cut)
cm.menu.align: {icon:film} Fit the video to this cut (fix the {icon:triangle-alert} mismatch)
cm.menu.label: Edit label, lyrics and notes (right panel)
cm.menu.del: {icon:trash-2} Delete this cut (merge into the previous cut)
cm.menu.noCut: There is no cut here. Drag the edge of a neighboring cut to widen it
cm.menu.note: Drag an edge to move the boundary (the neighbor moves too). Video clips stay put
cm.cutFrom.tip: Make this clip's start-to-end range a cut on the cuts lane (splits an existing cut, or adds one where there is none)
cm.cutFrom.tipV: Make this clip's start-to-end range a cut on the cuts lane (splits an existing cut, or adds one where there is none). Also sets this video clip's cut to that label
cm.cutAdopt: Make this range a cut when adopting (remembered for the project, also for adopt all)

au.title: {icon:volume-2} Audio
img.title: {icon:image} Image
img.camera: Camera (a list of [seconds, zoom, center x, center y]; empty: the whole frame)

batch.armed: {icon:speech} Click again within 5 seconds to regenerate all {n} lines
batch.streak: stopped after 3 failures in a row
trk.name: Name
